summary: Hosted/production deployment needs an explicit authenticated user/account boundary; current beta API routes have no visible runtime authentication/authorization dependency.
Booking proposal approval currently relies on proposal_id existence and has no account/owner authorization binding; random IDs do not replace object-level authorization.
Full plan number and member ID are persisted in plaintext JSON in local SQLite proposal state; production design should minimize retention and isolate/encrypt any identifiers that must be stored.
Approval must become an attributable, expiring, terms-bound, one-time authorization event before transaction adapters can act.
A separate security/audit event model and least-privilege service identities are required before live integrations.
evidence_basis: repository inspection of app.py, models.py, workflow.py, storage.py, project_guard.py
OWASP API Security API1:2023 and authorization/logging/cryptographic storage guidance
